paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of Nb25Mo25Ta25W25 and Ti8Nb23Mo23Ta23W23 high entropy alloys prepared by mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering

evidence.quote: Nb 25Mo25Ta25W25 and Ti 8Nb23Mo23Ta23W23 refractory high entropy alloys (HEAs) were successfully prepared by mechanical alloying (MA) and spark plasma sintering (SPS) technologies.
Nb 25Mo25Ta25W25 and Ti 8Nb23Mo23Ta23W23 refractory high entropy alloys (HEAs) were successfully prepared by mechanical alloying (MA) and spark plasma sintering (SPS) technologies.

The raw powders were milled in a planetary ball milling (QM-DY4, China) with tungsten carbide grinding media under high purity argon atmosphere. The ball-to-powder weight ratio was 15:1 and the milling speed was 400 rpm.
The milled powders were subsequently dried in vacuum for at least 24 h at 373 K
and then sintered by Spark Plasma Sintering System (SE-607, Germany) at 1873 K for 8 min with an axial pressure of 35 MPa under vacuum.
